Ammonia Gas Leak Kills Seven at Tamil Nadu Seafood Factory

An ammonia gas leak at a seafood export unit in Tamil Nadu has resulted in the deaths of seven workers and hospitalized dozens more. The incident occurred at a facility near Periyapalayam in Tiruvallur district, where many migrant workers were housed. Investigations have been ordered into the cause of the leak and potential negligence.
